description: Erection of a part single, part two storey rear extension, two storey side extension, front canopy and rear roof extension incorporating a hip to gable conversion with two front roof lights.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed first floor side and rear extensions due their size, scale and positioning, would result in an increased sense of enclosure, overbearingness, and a loss of outlook that would harm the living conditions of neighbouring properties. The proposed development would therefore be contrary to Local Plan Policies CC2 (Urban Design and Architecture) and SC7 (Residential Extensions and Alterations) and the intent of the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Reason : 2 - The proposed development by reason of its inappropriate size, scale, and design would fail to appear subservient and proportionate the host dwelling and would unbalance the appearance of the semi-detached pair. The proposal would result in harm to the character and appearance of the host property and wider area, contrary to Local Plan Policies CC1 (Context and Character), CC2 (Urban Design and Architecture), and SC7 (Residential Extensions and Alterations), and the intent of the Residential Extension Guidelines.
